incident.description: A delivery van accidentally struck parked DEMO-CAR-01 and damaged its rear panel on 2026-10-20.

citations.quote: C1: Sudden accidental external collision damage to DEMO-CAR-01 during the effective period is covered when the incident is established by an incident report identifying the claim reference, date, vehicle and cause.

A second examiner contradicts report IR-1001: the vehicle was moving in a timed motor race when it struck the van. The two reports disagree on whether racing caused the damage. No independent resolution has been supplied. Human review is required.

result.reason: E0 supports an accidental collision matching C1, but E1 directly contradicts the cause (racing vs. parked/accidental) with no independent resolution; racing is excluded under X1 and accidental collision under X2 has no exclusion, so the conflicting accounts leave coverage, exclusion and the underlying incident all unresolved pending human review.

X1: Deliberately caused damage, racing and routine mechanical wear are excluded.

result.reason: Policy covers only sudden accidental external collision damage during the period.
